MapContext.moveToLocation(Object object)

If the longitude and latitude are not transferred, the map center is moved to the current anchor point by default. In this case, you need to set show-location to true (Android) for the map component so that the map center can be moved to a specified position,and will trigger a failure callback.

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
longitude Number No longitude
latitude Number No latitude
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function for interface invoking failure
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

//maml
<button bindtap="moveToLocation">moveToLocation</button>

//js
Page({
  data: {
    markers: [
      {
        id: 0,
        title: 'marker0',
        latitude: 31.984686,
        longitude: 118.574979,
        width: 10,
        height: 15,
        anchor: { x: 0.5, y: 0.5 },
      },
    ],
    latitude: 31.97934,
    longitude: 118.7673113,
    markersIndex: 1,
  },

  moveToSpecialLocation() {
    this.mapContext.moveToLocation({
      longitude: 118.79205,
      latitude: 32.03237,
      success(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
      fail(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
    });
  },
  moveToLocation() {
    this.mapContext.moveToLocation({
      success(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
      fail(res) {
        ma.showModal({
          content: res.errMsg,
        });
      },
    });
  },
});
